dct_description_sm: This Forest Fire Danger Rating is a general depiction of the forest fire danger ratings for various regions of Ontario. It is designed only to show the overall danger in large areas as: * Low * Medium * High * Extreme * No Data (when applicable,) There may be more specific reports of conditions from municipalities or townships. Check specific danger conditions and possible fire restrictions with local authorities. The [Forest Fire Info Map](https://www.lioapplications.lrc.gov.on.ca/ForestFireInformationMap/index.html?viewer=FFIM.FFIM) shows active fires, current fire danger and restricted fire zones in place due to high fire danger.
